```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(bsicons)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(DT)

# ---- Read and join the data once (outside the server) ------------------------
# Built by scripts/tea/02_clean_tea.R and 03_boundaries.R, copied here by 04_dashboard_data.R
tea <- read_csv("data/tea_district_year.csv",
                col_types = cols(district = col_character()), show_col_types = FALSE)
districts <- readRDS("data/tx_districts_web.rds")   # EPSG:4326, what Leaflet expects

# One row per mapped district x school year x action. Charter networks have no
# boundary, so the inner join keeps traditional districts only.
tea_sf <- districts |>
  select(district, county, locale_type) |>
  inner_join(filter(tea, charter == "Traditional ISD"), by = "district") |>
  mutate(name = str_replace(str_to_title(distname), "\\bIsd\\b", "ISD"))

measures <- c("Black/White risk ratio"    = "rrr_black",
              "Hispanic/White risk ratio" = "rrr_hispanic",
              "All students: risk (%)"    = "risk_all")
actions  <- c("Out-of-school suspension (OSS)" = "OSS",
              "In-school suspension (ISS)"     = "ISS",
              "DAEP placement"                 = "DAEP")
years    <- sort(unique(tea$school_year))

# Colour classes (same as the static maps in maps.qmd)
ratio_breaks <- c(0, 0.8, 1.25, 2, 3, 5, Inf)
ratio_labels <- c("Under 0.8", "0.8 to 1.25 (about equal)", "1.25 to 2", "2 to 3", "3 to 5", "5 or more")
ratio_cols   <- c("#7FA6D3", "#F4EFE9", "#F6CDB0", "#E99A68", "#C8551E", "#7A2C0E")
risk_breaks  <- c(0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 10, Inf)
risk_labels  <- c("Under 1%", "1 to 2%", "2 to 4%", "4 to 6%", "6 to 10%", "10% or more")
risk_cols    <- c("#FBE3D2", "#F6C4A2", "#EE9D6C", "#DB7440", "#B44816", "#6B260B")
na_col       <- "#CCCCCC"
accent       <- "#C8551E"

theme_dash <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#2B2622"),
          plot.title.position = "plot",
          plot.caption = element_text(colour = "#8C837C", hjust = 0),
          plot.caption.position = "plot",
          axis.text = element_text(colour = "#5E5650"))
}
```

# {.sidebar}

```{r}
selectInput("measure", "Measure", choices = measures)
radioButtons("action", "Discipline action", choices = actions)
selectInput("year", "School year", choices = years, selected = max(years))
selectInput("locale", "Districts",
            choices = c("All districts" = "All", "City", "Suburb", "Town", "Rural"))
```

**How to read the risk ratio.** The share of Black (or Hispanic) students who received the action at least once, divided by the same share for White students in the same district. **1** means equal; **2** means twice as likely.

Districts where TEA masked a number, or where a group has fewer than 30 students, are **grey**.

<small>Data: Texas Education Agency, Discipline Action Group Summary Reports, 2018-19 to 2023-24. Boundaries: NCES EDGE 2023-24 (Census TIGER/Line 2024).</small>

```{r}
#| context: server

# ---- One shared reactive: the filtered sf data ------------------------------
dat <- reactive({
  d <- tea_sf |> filter(school_year == input$year, action == input$action)
  if (input$locale != "All") d <- filter(d, locale_type == input$locale)
  reliable <- switch(input$measure,
    rrr_black    = d$rrr_black_reliable,
    rrr_hispanic = d$rrr_hispanic_reliable,
    risk_all     = !is.na(d$risk_all) & d$enrolled_all >= 30)
  d$value <- ifelse(reliable %in% TRUE, d[[input$measure]], NA_real_)
  d
})

is_ratio <- reactive(input$measure != "risk_all")
group    <- reactive(switch(input$measure, rrr_black = "Black", rrr_hispanic = "Hispanic", "All"))
var_label <- reactive({
  if (is_ratio()) sprintf("%s/White risk ratio, %s (times as likely)", group(), input$action)
  else sprintf("Students with at least one %s (%% of all students)", input$action)
})
big <- function(x) formatC(x, big.mark = ",", format = "d")
fmt <- function(x) {
  if (is_ratio()) ifelse(is.na(x), "no reliable value", sprintf("%.2f", x))
  else ifelse(is.na(x), "no reliable value", sprintf("%.1f%%", x))
}

# ---- Value boxes ------------------------------------------------------------
output$n_value <- renderText(sprintf("%d of %s", sum(!is.na(dat()$value)), big(nrow(dat()))))
output$n_title <- renderText("Districts with a reliable value")
output$med_title <- renderText(if (is_ratio()) "Median risk ratio" else "Median risk")
output$med_value <- renderText({
  m <- median(dat()$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.na(m)) "–" else if (is_ratio()) sprintf("%.2f×", m) else sprintf("%.1f%%", m)
})
output$coverage <- renderText({
  d <- sf::st_drop_geometry(dat())
  n <- switch(input$measure, rrr_black = d$n_black, rrr_hispanic = d$n_hispanic, d$enrolled_all)
  share <- sum(n[!is.na(d$value)], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(n, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (is.nan(share)) "–" else sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * share)
})
output$coverage_title <- renderText(
  sprintf("%s covered by these districts",
          switch(group(), Black = "Black students", Hispanic = "Hispanic students", "All students")))

# ---- Map: draw the base once, then update the polygons ----------------------
# The output is called "district_map", not "map": Quarto gives the "Map" page the
# HTML id "map", and a second element with the same id would catch the updates.
output$district_map <- renderLeaflet(
  leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 4, zoomSnap = 0.25, zoomDelta = 0.5)) |>
    addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldGrayCanvas) |>
    fitBounds(-106.4, 25.9, -93.6, 36.4)
)

observe({
  d <- dat()
  if (is_ratio()) { brks <- ratio_breaks; labs <- ratio_labels; cols <- ratio_cols }
  else            { brks <- risk_breaks;  labs <- risk_labels;  cols <- risk_cols }
  cls <- cut(d$value, brks, labels = labs, right = FALSE)
  d$fill <- ifelse(is.na(cls), na_col, cols[as.integer(cls)])

  hover <- sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s: %s", d$name,
                   if (is_ratio()) "Risk ratio" else "Risk", fmt(d$value)) |>
    lapply(htmltools::HTML)
  popup <- sprintf(paste0(
    "<b>%s</b><br>%s County · %s<br><hr style='margin:4px 0'>",
    "<b>%s:</b> %s<br>",
    "Black students: %s%% of %s<br>Hispanic students: %s%% of %s<br>",
    "White students: %s%% of %s<br>All students: %s%% of %s"),
    d$name, str_remove(d$county, " County$"), d$locale_type, var_label(), fmt(d$value),
    ifelse(is.na(d$risk_black), "masked", sprintf("%.1f", d$risk_black)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$n_black), "masked", big(d$n_black)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$risk_hispanic), "masked", sprintf("%.1f", d$risk_hispanic)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$n_hispanic), "masked", big(d$n_hispanic)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$risk_white), "masked", sprintf("%.1f", d$risk_white)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$n_white), "masked", big(d$n_white)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$risk_all), "masked", sprintf("%.1f", d$risk_all)),
    big(d$enrolled_all))

  leafletProxy("district_map", data = d) |>
    clearShapes() |>
    clearControls() |>
    addPolygons(fillColor = ~fill, fillOpacity = 0.85, color = "white", weight = 0.4,
                label = hover, popup = popup,
                labelOptions = labelOptions(direction = "auto"),
                # bringToFront = FALSE: moving the hovered polygon to the top makes
                # Chrome miss the mouse-out event, so hover labels get stuck on screen
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2.5, color = "#2B2622",
                                                    fillOpacity = 1, bringToFront = FALSE)) |>
    addLegend(position = "bottomright", colors = c(cols, na_col),
              labels = c(labs, "No reliable value"), opacity = 0.85,
              title = HTML(str_replace(var_label(), " \\(", "<br>(")))
})

# ---- Companion chart: top 10 districts --------------------------------------
output$top10 <- renderPlot({
  d <- dat() |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> filter(!is.na(value)) |>
    slice_max(value, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
  validate(need(nrow(d) > 0, "No district has a reliable value for this selection."))
  n_col <- switch(input$measure, rrr_black = "n_black", rrr_hispanic = "n_hispanic", "enrolled_all")
  d <- d |> mutate(label = sprintf("%s (%s)", name, big(.data[[n_col]])),
                   label = reorder(label, value))
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(value, label)) +
    geom_col(fill = accent, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = fmt(value)), hjust = -0.15, size = 4, colour = "#2B2622") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
    labs(title = sprintf("Highest: %s, %s", d$name[1], fmt(d$value[1])),
         x = var_label(), y = NULL,
         caption = sprintf("In brackets: number of %s enrolled. Source: TEA, %s.",
                           switch(group(), Black = "Black students", Hispanic = "Hispanic students",
                                  "students"), input$year)) +
    theme_dash()
  if (is_ratio()) p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#5E5650")
  p
})

# ---- Trend page (all years, same action and locale) -------------------------
output$trend <- renderPlot({
  d <- tea_sf |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> filter(action == input$action)
  if (input$locale != "All") d <- filter(d, locale_type == input$locale)
  tr <- bind_rows(
    d |> filter(rrr_black_reliable) |> mutate(group = "Black / White", v = rrr_black),
    d |> filter(rrr_hispanic_reliable) |> mutate(group = "Hispanic / White", v = rrr_hispanic)
  ) |>
    summarise(med = median(v), q1 = quantile(v, 0.25), q3 = quantile(v, 0.75), n = n(),
              .by = c(group, school_year, year_start))
  validate(need(nrow(tr) > 0, "No reliable risk ratios for this selection."))
  last <- tr |> filter(year_start == max(year_start))
  ggplot(tr, aes(year_start, med, colour = group, fill = group)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 2018.5, xmax = 2020.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "grey92") +
    annotate("text", x = 2019.5, y = Inf, label = "COVID disruption", vjust = 1.5,
             colour = "#8C837C", size = 4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "#5E5650") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q1, ymax = q3), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) + geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_text(data = last, aes(label = sprintf("%s\n%.2f×", str_remove(group, " / White"), med)),
              hjust = -0.08, size = 4.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Black / White" = accent, "Hispanic / White" = "#3A6FB0"),
                        aesthetics = c("colour", "fill"), guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2018:2023, labels = \(x) sprintf("%d-%02d", x, (x + 1) %% 100),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.04))) +
    labs(x = "School year", y = sprintf("Median risk ratio, %s (times as likely)", input$action),
         caption = paste0("Line: median across districts with a reliable ratio. Band: middle half of districts (25th to 75th percentile).\n",
                          "Dashed line: parity (1). Orange: Black/White; blue: Hispanic/White. Source: TEA.")) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_dash() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#ECE6E0"),
          plot.margin = margin(10, 70, 10, 10))
})

# ---- Data table ------------------------------------------------------------
output$table <- renderDT({
  dat() |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    transmute(District = name, County = str_remove(county, " County$"), Locale = locale_type,
              `Students` = enrolled_all,
              `% Black` = round(pct_black, 1), `% Hispanic` = round(pct_hispanic, 1),
              `% White` = round(pct_white, 1), `% econ. disadvantaged` = round(pct_econ_dis, 1),
              `Risk, all (%)` = round(risk_all, 2), `Risk, Black (%)` = round(risk_black, 2),
              `Risk, Hispanic (%)` = round(risk_hispanic, 2), `Risk, White (%)` = round(risk_white, 2),
              `Black/White ratio` = if_else(rrr_black_reliable, round(rrr_black, 2), NA_real_),
              `Hispanic/White ratio` = if_else(rrr_hispanic_reliable, round(rrr_hispanic, 2), NA_real_)) |>
    arrange(desc(Students)) |>
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top",
              options = list(pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE),
              caption = "Risk = % of the group with at least one action. Ratios shown only where reliable. Source: TEA; NCES EDGE.")
})
```
